meta.description: Curated fragrance recommendations from Arielle's scent profile consultations

recommendations.name: Vetiver Fauve
recommendations.notes: Fig, vetiver, patchouli, jungle accord
recommendations.profileNote: Highest-priority unfound fragrance. Hits all three anchor notes simultaneously. L'Art & La Matiere line — online only regionally.

recommendations.name: Debaser
recommendations.notes: Fig, green stems, iris, moss, tonka
recommendations.profileNote: Confirmed purchase. Buy the body wash and lotion for longevity layering. At Refinery Nashville and Indiehouse Atlanta.

recommendations.name: Viper Green
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, angelica, vetiver, patchouli
recommendations.profileNote: Nisrine Grilliet — same perfumer as Santal Greenery. Cold, bitter, mineral green. At Refinery Nashville.

recommendations.name: Hwyl
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, vetiver, cypress, thyme, Atlantic cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Most naturalistic incense fragrance identified. Japanese forest darkness. At Aesop Edgehill Nashville.

recommendations.name: Ouranon
recommendations.notes: Myrrh, patchouli, lavender, frankincense, vetiver
recommendations.profileNote: Earthier and more herbal than Hwyl. At Aesop Edgehill Nashville.

recommendations.name: Eremia
recommendations.notes: Tomato leaf, galbanum, iris, Atlantic cedar, vetiver
recommendations.profileNote: Most Corail Oscuro-adjacent fragrance in Aesop lineup. Bitter green photorealistic. At Aesop Edgehill Nashville.

recommendations.name: Interlude Man
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, labdanum, opoponax, oregano, leather, patchouli, agarwood
recommendations.profileNote: Most complex dark incense fragrance on the list. Nothing like conventional men's cologne. At Refinery Nashville.

recommendations.name: Profumum Roma Olibanum
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, myrrh, pine resin, sandalwood
recommendations.profileNote: Pure frankincense benchmark. Ancient cathedral quality, linear and powerful.

recommendations.name: Calahorra
recommendations.notes: Thyme, patchouli, rosewood, resin, sage
recommendations.profileNote: 39% concentration. Green-resinous-earthy. Online purchase.

recommendations.name: Patchouli 24
recommendations.notes: Birch tar, labdanum, vanilla, smoke, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Annick Menardo. The birch tar-labdanum-smoke axis at its most direct. At Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Vetiver 46
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, olibanum, labdanum, clove, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Vetiver and frankincense as co-equals. At Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Ippuku
recommendations.notes: Fig, matcha, sandalwood, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Scent Split decant only — approx $30. Fig-matcha-sandalwood.

recommendations.name: French Lover
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, angelica, myrrh, vetiver, patchouli, oakmoss, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Pierre Bourdon. Potentially the most essential undiscovered fragrance — the note list is your entire profile in one bottle.

recommendations.name: Coven
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, oakmoss, labdanum, cedarwood, clove, vanilla, whiskey
recommendations.profileNote: Celine Barel. Reviewers use the word photorealistic without prompting. Cold dark galbanum over oakmoss and labdanum.

recommendations.name: Neroli Outrenoir
recommendations.notes: Smoked tea, neroli, petitgrain, bergamot, citrus, oakmoss, myrrh, benzoin
recommendations.profileNote: Immediately captured attention. Light-over-shadow architecture. Not at Nashville Nordstrom — online only regionally.

recommendations.name: Wulong Cha X
recommendations.notes: Green oolong tea, bergamot, yuzu, mandarin, fig, thyme, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Julien Rasquinet. Confirmed love. Citrus-tea-herb-fig photorealistic. At Indiehouse Atlanta.

recommendations.name: Sycomore
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, cypress, juniper, tobacco, sandalwood, pink pepper, violet
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Polge and Christopher Sheldrake. One of the most important vetiver fragrances in existence.

recommendations.name: Dryad
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, narcissus, oakmoss, iris, sage, vetiver, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Liz Moores. Reviewers use the word photorealistic without prompting. Potentially the most important undiscovered fragrance for your profile.

recommendations.name: Irish Leather
recommendations.notes: Juniper berry, clary sage, iris, green mate, cedar, vetiver, green leather
recommendations.profileNote: Juniper, clary sage, mate, vetiver base. First breath of freezing morning air.

recommendations.name: Myrrh Shadow
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, blackcurrant leaf, grapefruit, basil, timut pepper, cinnamon, cypress, myrrh, benzoin, Akigalawood, patchouli, atlas cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Nashville win. Bridges all three profile registers simultaneously. At Perfumology Nashville.

recommendations.name: Voodoo Chile
recommendations.notes: Rosemary, patchouli, cannabis, vetiver, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Most profile-aligned DVN you do not own yet. Sample before buying. At Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Crazy Basil
recommendations.notes: Basil, clary sage, green accord, cedar, woody notes
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Sample alongside Voodoo Chile. At Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Geranium Pour Monsieur
recommendations.notes: Geranium, mint, clary sage, cedar, vetiver
recommendations.profileNote: Dominique Ropion. Cold photorealistic garden. Geranium is one of your most confirmed naturalistic notes.

recommendations.name: Bel Respiro
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, rosemary, thyme, rose, grasses, cedar, myrrh, leather
recommendations.profileNote: Galbanum as primary green note — same cold stemmy bitter green pepper quality as Viper Green.

recommendations.name: B683
recommendations.notes: Saffron, rose, iris, patchouli, vetiver, cedar, myrrh, ambrette
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Ganymede's darker, more grounded sibling. At La Jetee Nashville.

recommendations.name: Cornucopia
recommendations.notes: Fig, incense, tobacco, clove, oud, ambergris
recommendations.profileNote: Julien Rasquinet — same perfumer as Wulong Cha X. Fig-incense-tobacco-oud.

recommendations.name: Flux
recommendations.notes: Cardamom, menthol, blueberry, eucalyptus, cypress, fir needles, cedarwood, sequoia, cashmere
recommendations.profileNote: Celine Barel 2025. Cold photorealistic forest. Test blueberry on skin.

recommendations.name: Memoir Man
recommendations.notes: Wormwood, basil, absinthe, artemisia, vetiver, tobacco, incense, castoreum
recommendations.profileNote: Dark gothic incense — wormwood-vetiver-tobacco-smoke.

recommendations.name: Opus XIV Royal Tobacco
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, myrrh, birch tar, labdanum, vetiver, tonka, guaiac wood, oud
recommendations.profileNote: Material-rich dark incense. Birch tar connects to Patchouli 24 territory.

recommendations.name: MAAI
recommendations.notes: Labdanum, oakmoss, civet, myrrh, incense, rose, castoreum
recommendations.profileNote: Most animalic and challenging fragrance on the list. Sample before buying.

recommendations.name: Bal d'Afrique Absolu
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, African marigold, black amber, bergamot, cedar, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Confirmed love — sets a very high bar alongside Philosykos and Debaser.

recommendations.name: Encens Mythique d'Orient
recommendations.notes: Olibanum, patchouli, vetiver, ambergris, labdanum
recommendations.profileNote: L'Art & La Matiere — online only regionally. Dark incense over patchouli-vetiver.

recommendations.name: Oud Cadenza
recommendations.notes: Myrrh, labdanum, incense, oud, dates, rose
recommendations.profileNote: Jordi Fernandez. At Indiehouse Atlanta.

recommendations.name: Misiones
recommendations.notes: Olibanum, myrrh, cistus, humid forest, copaiba
recommendations.profileNote: Most naturalistic incense fragrance on list. South American forest context.

recommendations.name: Through the Forest
recommendations.notes: Elemi, saffron, incense, tobacco, Vietnamese oud, sandalwood
recommendations.profileNote: Dark campfire-jungle aesthetic. At Refinery Nashville.

recommendations.name: Dark
recommendations.notes: Leather, vetiver, patchouli, oud, labdanum, tobacco, ginger
recommendations.profileNote: Prehistoric naturalism. Primitive, earthy, uncompromising.

recommendations.name: Us
recommendations.notes: Cade oil, smoke, vetiver, conifer, dark forest, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Cade is juniper tar — same material family as Orpheon's juniper.

recommendations.name: Silky Woods
recommendations.notes: Australian oud, tobacco, saffron, olibanum, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Smooth Australian oud. At Refinery Nashville.

recommendations.name: Spell 125
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, conifers, hemlock, ambergris, resin, pine
recommendations.profileNote: Liz Moores. Witchy dark forest, resinous pine, earthy cave atmosphere.

recommendations.name: Ambre Sultan
recommendations.notes: Amber, benzoin, coriander, oregano, bay leaf, resins, vanilla
recommendations.profileNote: Moroccan apothecary quality. Herbal-resinous amber. At La Jetee Nashville.

recommendations.name: Fille en Aiguilles
recommendations.notes: Pine needles, frankincense, vetiver, fir balsam, bay, honey sap, spices
recommendations.profileNote: Photorealistic fir forest with incense. One of the most celebrated dark-incense fragrances in niche canon.

recommendations.name: Encens et Lavande
recommendations.notes: Olibanum, lavender, resin, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Highest natural olibanum content in any commercial fragrance.

recommendations.name: Encens Suave
recommendations.notes: Somali frankincense, coffee, benzoin, vanilla, opoponax, labdanum, amber
recommendations.profileNote: Aurelien Guichard. Coffee opening makes frankincense feel specific and naturalistic.

recommendations.name: Falcon Leather
recommendations.notes: Cedar, oud, iris, vetiver, suede, smoke, patchouli
recommendations.profileNote: Aurelien Guichard. Real leather not a smooth accord. Try EDP not Extrait.

recommendations.name: Mortal Skin
recommendations.notes: Ink, blackberry, incense, labdanum, myrrh, iris, cardamom, artemisia, styrax, birch, cedar, ambergris
recommendations.profileNote: Ink-incense-myrrh-labdanum-iris-artemisia-birch. Test blackberry on skin before committing.

recommendations.name: Nomade EDP
recommendations.notes: Violet leaf, oakmoss, vetiver, mirabelle plum, cedarwood
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Cold-green-earthy. Sample at Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, oakmoss, cedar, sandalwood, cardamom, fresh herb, sap accord
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Photorealistic naturalistic woody-green. Travel size at Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: En Passant
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, basil, calamus, lilac, petrichor, wheat, sandalwood, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Olivia Giacobetti. Rain-kissed lilac over galbanum-wheat-petrichor.

recommendations.name: Afternoon Swim
recommendations.notes: Sicilian orange, mandarin, bergamot, ginger, ambergris
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Confirmed love. Photorealistic vivid orange.

recommendations.name: Porthole
recommendations.notes: Pineapple, sea salt, bergamot, iodine, passionfruit, ginger, white blossom, caramel, woods
recommendations.profileNote: Confirmed love. Iodine-salt is the key — volcanic coastal specificity.

recommendations.name: Imagination
recommendations.notes: Black tea, ginger, bergamot, citron, neroli, cinnamon, guaiac wood, olibanum
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Citrus-tea-ginger-olibanum. Strong candidate given Wulong Cha X and Neroli Outrenoir loves.

recommendations.name: Ombre Nomade
recommendations.notes: Oud, incense, rose, raspberry, saffron, birch, amberwood, benzoin
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Most celebrated LV dark fragrance.

recommendations.name: L'Artisan Tea for Two
recommendations.notes: Lapsang souchong, ginger, cinnamon, anise, vanilla, cardamom
recommendations.profileNote: Smoked lapsang souchong is the most photorealistic tea material available. Sample via Scent Split.

recommendations.name: Masque Milano Hemingway
recommendations.notes: Ginger, rhubarb, vetiver, leather, cedar, patchouli
recommendations.profileNote: Most directly profile-aligned ginger fragrance. Available in 10ml travel sizes.

recommendations.name: Bvlgari Pour Homme EDP
recommendations.notes: Darjeeling tea, ginger, Ceylon tea, guaiac wood, ambrette, white musk
recommendations.profileNote: Jean-Claude Ellena lineage. Darjeeling and ginger. At Nordstrom and Sephora.

recommendations.name: Orpheon EDP
recommendations.notes: Juniper berry, jasmine sambac, cedar, tonka bean, galbanum, vetiver, cistus, benzoin
recommendations.profileNote: Confirmed love — juniper-galbanum-vetiver base. Travel size on Nashville buy list.

recommendations.name: Hacivat
recommendations.notes: Bergamot, pineapple, oakmoss, patchouli, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Most discussed Nishane on social media. Given Wulong Cha X love, worth exploring. At Indiehouse Atlanta.

recommendations.name: Un Jardin en Mediterranee
recommendations.notes: Fig, cedar, cypress, mastic, laurel, date tree
recommendations.profileNote: Jean-Claude Ellena. Photorealistic Mediterranean garden.

recommendations.name: Un Jardin apres la Mousson
recommendations.notes: Ginger, vetiver, pepper, coriander, petrichor, green
recommendations.profileNote: Jean-Claude Ellena. Kerala after monsoon. Sample at Nordstrom Nashville.

recommendations.name: Terre d'Hermes
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, flint, orange, pepper, cedar, benzoin
recommendations.profileNote: Jean-Claude Ellena. Classic dark-citrus over mineral-vetiver.

recommendations.name: Jazz Club
recommendations.notes: Tobacco leaf, rum, vetiver, vanilla, musk, pink pepper
recommendations.profileNote: Boozy-resinous cold-weather pick. At Nordstrom Nashville and Sephora.

recommendations.name: From the Garden
recommendations.notes: Tomato leaf, geranium, patchouli, green herbs
recommendations.profileNote: Tomato leaf and geranium. Poor value at $140/30ml — sample at Nordstrom first.

recommendations.name: Ingenious Ginger
recommendations.notes: Ginger flower, bergamot, cardamom, Australian sandalwood, amber
recommendations.profileNote: Confirmed preference. On Nashville buy list as 50ml full bottle.

recommendations.name: Iris Malkhan
recommendations.notes: Galbanum, iris, labdanum, leather, woody notes
recommendations.profileNote: Quentin Bisch. Cold earthy iris over galbanum-labdanum-leather. At Indiehouse Atlanta.

recommendations.name: A Midnight Stroll
recommendations.notes: Incense, cade wood, cypress, woody notes
recommendations.profileNote: Photorealistic dark forest. Cade is juniper tar. Year-round wearable in Alabama.

recommendations.notes: Limone cedrato, neroli, verbena, oakmoss, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Oakmoss grounds the citrus-neroli in your naturalistic register.

recommendations.name: Heeley Cardinal
recommendations.notes: Frankincense, benzoin, vetiver, cedar, paper
recommendations.profileNote: Bright airy frankincense over benzoin-vetiver. Accessible incense benchmark.

recommendations.name: Hippie Rose
recommendations.notes: Rose, patchouli, incense, vetiver, amber, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Rose done naturalistically — patchouli-incense-vetiver base prevents sweetness.

recommendations.name: Vetiver Extraordinaire
recommendations.notes: Vetiver, oakmoss, bergamot, pink pepper, cloves, incense, cedar, myrrh
recommendations.profileNote: Dominique Ropion. Test on skin — some noses find synthetic quality.

recommendations.name: Noir Epices
recommendations.notes: Clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, cardamom, saffron, cedar, sandalwood, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Michel Roudnitska. Ancient spice cabinet — warm, dry, resinous, medicinal.

recommendations.name: Bigarade Concentree
recommendations.notes: Bitter orange, cedarwood, musk, green notes
recommendations.profileNote: Jean-Claude Ellena. Most photorealistic orange in perfumery.

recommendations.name: Coromandel
recommendations.notes: Patchouli, benzoin, labdanum, incense, white flowers, orange, cedarwood
recommendations.profileNote: Test for orange blossom heart — may trigger your reaction. Patchouli-benzoin-labdanum base is your world.

recommendations.name: Osmo
recommendations.notes: Marine, oakmoss, pink pepper, orris, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Inspired by Reynisfjara volcanic beach Iceland. Marine here is mineral-iodic not synthetic.

recommendations.name: Birch
recommendations.notes: Birch, pine, birch tar, smoke, vetiver
recommendations.profileNote: Photorealistic birch forest with tar and smoke. Birch tar-vetiver direct dark register.

recommendations.name: Masque Milano Russian Tea
recommendations.notes: Mint, black tea, leather, birch, raspberry, tobacco
recommendations.profileNote: Photorealistic dark tea. Available in 10ml travel sizes direct.

recommendations.name: Just a Rose
recommendations.notes: Rose absolute, mate absolute, patchouli, guaiac wood, bergamot, tonka
recommendations.profileNote: Nashville win. Mate absolute grounds the rose.

recommendations.name: I Am Coming Home
recommendations.notes: Ginger oil, cardamom, white tea, bergamot, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Nashville win. Ginger-white tea-bergamot — photorealistic botanical register.

recommendations.name: Dear Lord
recommendations.notes: Palo santo, papyrus, bergamot, vanilla, sandalwood, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Nashville win. Palo santo is a sacred resinous South American wood.

recommendations.name: Faces of Frances
recommendations.notes: Saffron, aldehydes, pistachio, driftwood, juniper, oud, styrax, ambergris, vetiver, cypriol
recommendations.profileNote: Nashville win. Bertrand Duchaufour. Saffron-juniper-cypriol-vetiver-oud.

recommendations.name: Eau de Gingembre
recommendations.notes: Ginger, bergamot, neroli, fig, white woods, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Alberto Morillas own house. Ginger over bergamot-neroli resolving into fig and white woods.

recommendations.name: On the Beach
recommendations.notes: Yuzu, neroli, thyme, rosemary, cloves, pink pepper, cypress, cedarwood
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Thyme and rosemary make this photorealistic herb not generic beach.

recommendations.name: Megamare
recommendations.notes: Iodine, sea salt, seagrass, mineral, musk, ambergris
recommendations.profileNote: Photorealistic coastal — iodine and salt dominant. Porthole territory.

recommendations.name: Bois d'Ascese
recommendations.notes: Birch tar, smoke, cedar, vetiver, incense
recommendations.profileNote: Austere naturalistic dark wood study. Very hard to find — Luckyscent carries it.

recommendations.name: Shadow People
recommendations.notes: Oakmoss, cold vapor, static electricity accord, damp earth, wool, lanolin
recommendations.profileNote: Chelsea Wolfe collab. Cold mineral-earthy with static electricity accord.

recommendations.name: Nuit de Feu
recommendations.notes: Incense, olibanum, leather, agarwood, musk, amber
recommendations.profileNote: Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Darkest LV — pure incense-leather-oud, no sweetness.

recommendations.name: Atelier des Fleurs Sous les Pins
recommendations.notes: Pine, eucalyptus, Akigalawood, green notes, amber
recommendations.profileNote: 2026 release — call ahead for availability. Bridges naturalistic green with futuristic molecular register.

recommendations.name: Blue Talisman Extrait
recommendations.notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix, white tea, pear, magnolia, musk
recommendations.profileNote: Your futuristic-mineralic anchor. Cold, luminous, molecular.

recommendations.name: AO
recommendations.notes: Fig, myrrh, vetiver, violet, cedar
recommendations.profileNote: Try list not buy list. Sample before spending $200.

recommendations.name: Apres l'Ondee
recommendations.notes: Violet, iris, heliotrope, anise, petrichor, musk
recommendations.profileNote: The canonical atmospheric violet taken in the darkest most rain-soaked direction.

recommendations.name: Anubis
recommendations.notes: Jasmine, suede, frankincense, sandalwood, labdanum, pink lotus, immortelle, saffron
recommendations.profileNote: Liz Moores. Test skin reaction before committing — processed jasmine but still present.

recommendations.name: Krigler Lovely Patchouli 55
recommendations.notes: Raw Philippine patchouli, earthy green accord
recommendations.profileNote: Jackie Kennedy signature. Naturalistic raw patchouli — earthy not sweet. Sample from krigler.com first.

recommendations.name: DeGrhaal Olibanum
recommendations.notes: Bergamot, ginger, elemi, incense, cardamom, violet, neroli, ambergris, sandalwood, myrrh, musk
recommendations.profileNote: 2024. Ginger-elemi opening over myrrh-ambergris base. Test neroli on skin given orange blossom sensitivity.
